title: Add bounded customer accounts-receivable reconciliation and aging workspace
description: Add a bounded read-only customer accounts-receivable reconciliation and aging workspace over ERP-055 customer sales-invoice evidence and ERP-073 explicit receipt-to-sales-invoice allocations. Derive only arithmetic evidence supported by persisted invoice dates, optional due dates and active allocations. Do not create a general ledger, invent due dates, contact customers, collect funds, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace lists recorded customer sales-invoice evidence and active explicit ERP-073 receipt allocations without copying source rows or creating another invoice, receipt or allocation master.
Users can apply bounded or paged filters for Customer, invoice identity, invoice-date range, explicit due-date range, currency, invoice status and allocation state using persisted fields only.

For each recorded invoice, arithmetic remaining evidence equals invoice gross amount minus active ERP-073 allocations, with over-allocation prevented by source rules and voided allocations excluded but available in explicit history.

Aging is calculated only when an explicit persisted due date exists, against an explicit as-of date, using documented mutually exclusive buckets; invoices without due dates remain in a separate unknown-due-date group.
Different currencies are grouped separately and are never combined, converted or presented as one total without an authoritative persisted conversion already belonging to source evidence.

Draft or voided invoices are separately labeled and excluded from active receivables-evidence totals; missing, invalid or unavailable source links remain visible as unknown or invalid and are not repaired or reassigned.

The workspace distinguishes invoice gross evidence, explicit allocated-receipt evidence and arithmetic remainder and states that these are repository reconciliation figures, not a general-ledger balance, audited Customer statement, payment demand, revenue recognition, tax filing or settlement confirmation.

Opening invoice, allocation or receipt detail revalidates existing authentication and module authorization and fails closed when an authoritative source is deleted, unavailable or no longer authorized.
List and aggregate queries are bounded, avoid per-row database access, do not call external services and keep legacy Customers with no evidence readable without request-time or production backfill.
The workspace is read-only and does not change Customers, invoices, allocations, receipts, Sales Orders, containers, balances, tax, finance or settlement records.
Any export uses the same filtered, currency-separated and unknown-due-date semantics as the screen and contains no hidden cross-currency total or inferred legal assertion.

Unit and integration tests cover explicit and missing due dates, aging boundaries, partial and full allocations, void history, multiple Customers and currencies, as-of filtering, bounded queries, authorization failure and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open the customer receivable reconciliation workspace for recorded sales invoices with explicit due dates and partial receipt allocations, select an as-of date, and verify currency-separated remaining evidence and documented aging buckets.
Inspect draft, voided, missing-due-date, invalid-link and multi-currency evidence and verify unknown values remain separate, no cross-currency total is shown and no source record is changed.

human_gate.reason: Read-only arithmetic over repository evidence and non-production validation only. Customer contact, real collection, accounting or tax action, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
